what: Pairs of films no model has seen (posted 1 July - 14 November 2026): two films of one TikTok account, one that reached at least ten times the account's usual views (30 neighbouring films, at least 30,000 views, likes at least 2 %), one ordinary (0.3-1.3 times the usual, within 35 days, half to twice as long). One pair an account. Views, not sales. The films lie on this machine (hook-lab/ciftfilm, ciftfilm2), their pictures too; scripts: collect/filmpairs_*.py. EXAM: a chooser that has read this file is not tested on it; a fresh set is drawn by the same scripts in half an hour.
judge: Opus 5.5 at medium, blind, five frames (0, 0.5, 1, 2, 3.5 s) and the first words; s = sure, u = unsure; `taught` = the same eye after 24 solved pairs and the counts of set 1; `sol` = GPT-6.2 Sol at medium
